name: SGForum
subtitle: Communities worth joining
shortDescription: Discover discussions, share rich posts, message members, and build safer spaces.
description: SGForum brings community discovery, threaded conversation, rooms, direct messages, notifications, profiles, and moderation to a native mobile experience. Publish rich discussions and polls, follow replies, preserve your reading position, manage privacy preferences, and use transparent report and moderation workflows.
reviewNotes: Guest discovery is available immediately. The included review journey can create a local identity, post, message, report content, and exercise privacy controls.
releaseNotes: Initial mobile release with ranked feeds, rich threads, nested replies, rooms and messages, push handoff, moderation, admin controls, and privacy workflows.
